title: Safe Superintelligence picks Google Cloud TPUs as main compute

sources.quote: SSI’s deal with Google Cloud suggests the former will spend a large chunk of its computing budget with Google Cloud; a source familiar tells TechCrunch that Google Cloud is SSI’s primary computing provider.

explain: Ilya Sutskever's AI lab Safe Superintelligence rents Google's TPU chips through Google Cloud for its research, and Google Cloud is reportedly its main computing provider. No amount was disclosed.
